headline: 🔍 THE FIELDSTONE INSPECTION HAS A DATE AND THE BUYER SIDE IS WAITING ON YOU — their inspector's earliest is THURSDAY 8/13, the ask landed at 2:35 this afternoon, and no answer has gone back. ⚡ DO: say yes to Thursday on 1709 Fieldstone. ⚠️ WATCH: the 195 Lake View appraisal ran Friday morning and no value has surfaced anywhere in 32 hours — that is the number the whole file turns on.

notes: 🔑 THIRTEENTH CONSECUTIVE RUN THAT CANNOT PUBLISH — still the single most expensive unfixed thing in the fleet, and it is one command. All three boards were rebuilt and committed again this evening; none can ship. The GitHub CLI has been signed out since Monday's migration and the local-only commits keep stacking. What your phone shows is still Tuesday morning. `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, and six days of queued work goes out on the next pass.

✅ THE DAY CONVERTED TWICE AND BOTH ARE VERIFIED. 1709 Fieldstone went under contract at 9:05 this morning on the buyers' initialed contract, and their inspector was booked by 2:35 this afternoon — that is a buyer side moving fast, not stalling. Separately the 10:30 listing appointment held, the packet went to both sellers at 10:46, and they replied warm at 1:44 with a dated capital improvement for the MLS.

⚖️ THREE QUESTIONS ARE SITTING ON YOU AND EACH ONE BLOCKS A LANE THAT IS OTHERWISE READY. Your physical business address has been asked for since 9:25 this morning and its absence is now the only reason a hot never-contacted seller in Panama City got a staged draft instead of a sent email. The co-op-agent draft rule has been asked five times. And the recorder you wear has captured nothing in seventeen days — that is a device, not an outage, and it means nothing said out loud has reached any routine since 7/23.

callBlock.why: 🔑 SHE WROTE THE OFFER YOU KILLED THIS MORNING, AND HER BUYER WAS NEVER TOLD THE PRICE CAME DOWN. On her form she answered interested YES and wrote 'Writing up an offer!' while calling the old number too high — and the number came down $4,000 three days later with nobody telling her. ⚠️ Two weeks is long enough for that buyer to be under contract elsewhere, so treat this as a re-open, not a live offer. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only.

⭐ THE OTHER 'INTERESTED: YES' ON THE SAME LISTING, and the same story: her only objection was the price, and the price has since been answered. ⚠️ Her buyer was cross-shopping another house six days ago — that is either resolved or gone, and one call settles it. ⛔ Quote $295,000 and nothing else.

SHE ASKED FOR A PROFESSIONAL VALUATION IN HER OWN WORDS on 145 Detroit Ave. That is a seller raising her hand, not a lead to qualify. ✅ Her first-touch email went out this morning by your own hand — so the opener is done and the call is the follow-through, not the introduction.

THE FIRST AND ONLY REPLY THE RECONNECT LANE HAS EVER PRODUCED, now four days old — and he has since become both sides of a deal: he wants something inexpensive on Lay or Logan Martin, you sent him a valuation on his own place, and you are running his mortgage numbers. ⭐ A live buyer AND a live seller who raised his own hand, getting colder by the day.

🔴 STILL THE WORST NUMBER ON THIS LIST: ZERO TOUCHES, EVER, and now five days overdue. Third buyer off your 1709 Fieldstone ad, re-engaged himself on a Sunday afternoon, and nothing has gone out to him in any channel. ⭐ That listing is now under contract — which makes him a live buyer with no house attached, not a dead lead.

Fourth name off the 1709 Fieldstone ad in four days, landed 7:47 PM on a Sunday while the instant responder was dark. ⭐ Same point as Anthony M. — the ad that produced her just went under contract, so she is a buyer in your market with nothing left to look at.

Buyer who was live on your site fifteen minutes before her alert fired, on a $415K four-bed in Helena. ⭐ She is also the one confirmed pre-market-list ask on the board — she told you she wanted the ones that are not listed yet, which is a standing reason to call rather than a one-time trigger.

387 Appleford Rd in Helena with roughly $202K in equity, and dark since September 2025. ⭐ An equity-and-silence combination is the classic listing conversation — she is not waiting on you, which is exactly why the call is worth making.

listings.status: 🔍 UNDER CONTRACT $380K → INSPECTION — their inspector proposed THURSDAY 8/13 and the buyer side is waiting on your yes
listings.note: 🔍 THE NEWEST THING ON YOUR WHOLE BOARD, AND IT IS AN EASY YES. At 2:35 this afternoon the buyer's agent wrote that the earliest day his inspector had was Thursday and asked whether that works on your end, time still to be worked out. That is nine hours after the initialed contract landed — a buyer side moving at full speed. ⏰ It has not been answered. ⚠️ AND IT IS THE SECOND TIME TODAY THIS SIDE HAS GONE UNANSWERED IN WRITING: his close-date question from Friday morning is still the last message in its thread, now past thirty hours. Both were overtaken by events rather than replied to, and a co-op agent who has to chase twice starts pricing that into everything that follows. ⚠️ TWO PAPERWORK ITEMS REMAIN OPEN AND NEITHER IS DEAL RISK. The closing date is executed nowhere in writing — their 10/23 ask and your 10/30 position were never reconciled in a document any routine can read. And a fresh signature pull still shows one of your two sellers has opened the document twice and never signed, while your coordinator told the buyer's side Friday evening that the seller had signed. Both are receipted; nothing read today settles which surface is authoritative. ⭐ THE CONTRACT PDF HAS NOW GONE SIX DAYS UNOPENED BY ANY ROUTINE — every term on this file still comes from two agents' emails rather than from the paper, and thirty seconds with the attachment closes both questions at once. ⭐ Separately this listing is still the best lead source of your week: four names on tonight's call block came off this one ad.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — two showings booked this weekend and BOTH of its interested agents now have names
listings.note: 🔥 THE WEEKEND IS THE TEST. Two appointments are booked back to back — Sunday 1:30 and Monday 1:40 — on a listing where a single booking had been news, and they are the first traffic since the competing offer was confirmed dead at 8:18 this morning. ⭐ BOTH 'INTERESTED: YES' ROWS ON THIS FILE NOW HAVE NAMES, and both were anonymous until today: Cassie C. at RE/MAX Advantage wrote the 7/25 offer and Angela B. at Keller Williams Vestavia filed the 8/2 read. Each objected only to the old price. Neither was ever told it came down. Both calls are on tonight's list. ⛔ THE PRICE-QUOTE RULE MATTERS MORE NOW THAT YOU ARE PHONING TWO AGENTS: quote $295,000 and nothing else — across five written reads and one preview, not one agent has ever put a different number on paper. ⭐ The staging scores disagree with each other, which is the profile of a listing with no clear defect.

listings.status: ⚠️ Under contract $351K — the appraisal ran Friday morning and 32 hours later no value exists anywhere
listings.note: ⚠️ THE APPRAISAL IS NOW THE STORY, NOT THE REPAIR COUNTER. It ran Friday at 9:00 AM and no value has reported in any lane in about thirty-two hours. That is still inside normal, but it is the single number this entire file turns on and it has been checked and found absent on four separate passes today. ⏰ THE REPAIR ADDENDUM HAS SAT ON DOTLOOP UNANSWERED SINCE FRIDAY 6:35 PM — roughly twenty-three hours — over a gap of three hundred dollars on a $351,000 contract, with the seller handling HVAC and the other side already saying 'we'll get it signed asap'. Still the cheapest decision on your board. ⚠️ Older paper is unsigned too, on a file where the closing agent already holds the earnest money, and the buyers' own home-sale contingency has never been receipted. ⭐ For the seller conversation: contract price is $351,000, not the $369,000 list — every repair dollar comes off a net that already carries $8,000 in closing costs and a warranty.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — DAY FOUR UNRULED, and your listing agreement dies in six days
listings.note: 🔴 THE HARDEST DEADLINE ON YOUR BOARD AND THE ONLY ONE NOBODY IS TOUCHING. Your listing agreement expires 2026-08-14 — six days — while the counter under discussion proposes a contingency deadline more than two weeks past your authority to represent these sellers. ⏰ THE DECISION HAS BEEN OPEN SINCE 8/6 AND EVERY SWEEP TODAY FOUND ZERO NEW TRAFFIC IN ANY LANE — no email, no text, no voicemail on this file since the buyer's agent's second voicemail on 8/5. ⚠️ He asked for a counter number out loud, twice, and named his own buyer's ceiling while doing it — a buyer negotiating against himself, which only happens while he thinks somebody is listening. Four days of quiet is how that stops. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCE IS THE PROBLEM: you cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first — and it is the same call that gets the agreement extended.

listings.status: 🎉 The listing appointment HELD this morning — and they replied warm this afternoon
listings.note: 🎉 THE DAY'S SECOND REAL WIN, AND IT KEPT MOVING AFTER THE MEETING. You built the packet at 9:48 and forwarded it to both sellers at 10:46, sixteen minutes into the slot. ⭐ THEN THEY CAME BACK AT 1:44: 'Thanks Gene! FYI, the siding was completed October of 2021.' That answers neither open question — no signature, no price — but it banks a dated capital improvement straight into the MLS input, and an unprompted reply hours after a listing appointment is the tone you want. ⭐ THE BOARD ALSO EARNED A FACT IT HAD BEEN MISSING SINCE 7/20: the address and price band are known and a dossier exists for the first time. ⭐ It is a two-sided deal — they list this one and buy the next. ⚠️ Nothing is signed yet, which makes the follow-up the whole ballgame.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — closing Thursday Aug 20, with one signature and one document still owed
listings.note: ✅ THE DEAL IS CLEAN: inspections done including septic, appraisal complete, and the re-issued closing invite reads Thursday Aug 20 at 3:00 PM at the law firm. ⚠️ TWO ITEMS MOVED THIS MORNING AND NEITHER CLOSED. Your brokerage sent an action-required request for the commission document at 10:27 — that is the paperwork that makes the payout happen. And at 10:48 the other side OPENED the extension addendum and did not sign it. ⚠️ THAT SECOND ONE IS THE WHOLE REMAINING ITEM: everyone agrees the date in writing across three channels and nothing is executed. ⭐ Both candidate dates land in August so the forecast does not move — this is documentation risk, and one signature retires it entirely.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $164K — Friday evening's showing is now 24 hours old with no written read
listings.note: ⚠️ THE ONE TO WATCH TONIGHT. A showing ran Friday at 6:00 PM and no read has filed in about twenty-four hours — the freshest unanswered tour on the board, on the listing holding the only unqualified 'interested YES, priced just right' this board has ever taken. ✅ YOU CLOSED THE AGENT CALL LATE FRIDAY NIGHT, five days after that yes landed. ⚠️ CLOSING THE CALL DID NOT MOVE THE BLOCKER, BECAUSE THE BLOCKER IS A DECISION: authorize a concession and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⚠️ You still have not asked your seller for a number, and a decision with nothing behind it is theatre. ⭐ The unblocker is one question, and it is the same seller as Lake Crest and Martinwood — three files, one phone call. ⏰ This file has also read AGREEMENT EXPIRING since 7/22 with no date ever pulled from the notice — seventeen days of an unread clock.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $559K — too high on the first read since the contract died, and four days quiet since
listings.note: ⚠️ THE FIRST TOUR AFTER A RE-LIST IS THE READ A PROPERTY GETS GRADED ON, and this one came back too high with the worst staging score on file. The two reads before the contract both said JUST RIGHT, so the shift is real and recent. 🔴 A HARDER QUESTION IS STILL OPEN: there is no bond on the EIFS here. On synthetic stucco a buyer's inspector finds that independently, and it is a plausible part of why a contract already died once. ⏰ NO NEW TOUR HAS BEEN BOOKED SINCE 8/4 — four days — and the oldest read on this file ages out of the window tomorrow. ⭐ THE STAGING SCORE IS FIXABLE TODAY AND COSTS NOTHING. Fix that before anyone touches price.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $189K — the approved cut is sixteen days old, still unverified, and there is no feedback history left
listings.note: 🔴 THE RISK IS TWO PUBLIC PRICES, NOT A SLOW SALE. A cut was approved just over two weeks ago with no receipt anywhere that it took effect in the MLS — on a listing that has now gone twenty-seven days without a showing. ✅ Two minutes to pull the MLS line and close it. ⚠️ THIS FILE NOW HAS NO FEEDBACK HISTORY AT ALL — the single written read that ever said the price was too high has fallen outside the fourteen-day window. ⭐ Same seller as Altamont and Lake Crest — three files, one phone call.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $364K — a read validated your price ten days ago and the seller still has not been told
listings.note: 🔴 DAY TEN OF A SELLER NOT HEARING GOOD NEWS, and there is now a deadline on it: that read ages out of the fourteen-day window in three days, at which point the only positive datapoint this listing has ever produced disappears off the board. A price called JUST RIGHT by someone with no reason to flatter it, overall rating 4 of 5, is exactly what an out-of-state condo seller wants to hear. ⚠️ A validated price with no buyer is a marketing conversation — and you cannot have it with someone who does not know the price was validated.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — one tour in fourteen days, no written read, and the open house is eight days back
listings.note: ✅ THE MARKETING BLOCK ON THIS LISTING WAS A FALSE ALARM AND IT CLEARED TODAY. Yesterday's run reported the property photo-blocked; it had tested a filename that does not exist. All ten photos are live and a carousel ships this evening at 6:30. ⚠️ THE SHOWING SIDE IS STILL THE PROBLEM: your most expensive listing, sellers living in it, exactly one booked tour in fourteen days and no written feedback at all. ⏰ Sunday's open house is eight days back and exists only in your head — well past the point where detail survives. Five minutes of dictation makes it usable; another week and it is gone. ⭐ THE LAND COMPONENT IS PINNED: the parcel runs 40 acres, and the one written objection this file has ever taken was about the land, not the price.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — she read your pre-list plan Thursday and the tenant answer is now sixteen days owed
listings.note: ⭐ SHE WAS BACK ON THE SITE 38 MINUTES AFTER YOUR PRE-LIST EMAIL — that is a seller reading her own plan and thinking about it, and it is the warmest this file has been in two weeks. 🔴 A CLIENT WHO HAS TO CHASE TWICE ON SOMETHING ORDINARY STARTS ASSUMING THE HARDER QUESTIONS WILL GO THE SAME WAY. Sixty seconds, whether or not you have the answer. ✅ The ceiling-height video she asked for has gone out, so the reason to call is concrete rather than apologetic. ⚠️ The condo scope email you promised 'shortly' is still owed.

listings.note: ⚠️ A PRICE CUT NOBODY CAN SEE IS NOT A PRICE CUT. The reduction was made Wednesday and the announcement has sat as an unpublished draft ever since — two days of a listing carrying a stale public number while the seller believes it has been repriced. ⭐ Same failure shape as 821 Martinwood, and both are minutes to close. ✅ It is staged and waiting on approval, not lost.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the largest number on your board, and your written position still has not gone across
listings.note: 🔴 FIVE ASKS AND OVER TWO WEEKS OF SILENCE. Your own message told the other side you would entertain a reverse offer — a real position stated verbally with nothing on paper behind it. ⭐ The written feedback they have asked for five times IS your negotiating position; writing it is not a favour to them, it is putting your number on the record.

listings.status: 🔥 Cash deal — contract finalized and earnest money delivered; due diligence is the clock now
listings.note: 🔥 STILL THE FASTEST THING ON THIS BOARD BY A WIDE MARGIN — an offer-to-counter-to-counter round trip inside one day, and you confirmed Thursday night that the contract is finalized and earnest money is delivered. ✅ THE ACREAGE BLOCKER IS RETIRED: the seller's own two numbers imply roughly 157.6 acres — the first acreage ever stated on this tract — so the deal can be valued. ⏰ THE DUE-DILIGENCE PACKAGE IS STAGED AND UNSTARTED, waiting on your word: a dated checklist with one line per item, because a DD period is a clock and a single task cannot show what is about to expire. ⚠️ A small conflict between two acreage figures remains on file; it changes the math at the margins, not the deal. ⭐ Same Tyler whose separate offboarding notice from Real has still never been answered by him — Real replied and is actively helping.

Their listing has since gone EXPIRED, so the window where your feedback is still useful to them is closing.

pipeline.note: ✅ THESE NUMBERS COME FROM THEIR OWN SOURCE — the Weekly Pipeline & Forecast of Monday 8/3 states it plainly: Gene = 21, account-wide = 35. No fresher forecast has been issued since, so they are carried rather than re-derived. ⚠️ A COMPETING FIGURE OF 26 IS CIRCULATING IN THE ADVISOR LEDGER AND IT IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE — the forecast email is the system of record and it says 21. Recorded so no run re-litigates it in the other direction. 21 at day 220 is about 5.9 behind an on-pace 26.9 and annualises to 36. ⏰ THE REAL DEADLINE IS NOT DECEMBER 31 — at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything counting for 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31, now under twelve weeks. 🎉 AND ONE WENT ON THE BOARD TODAY: Fieldstone is under contract as of this morning, its inspection is being scheduled for Thursday, and it closes inside 2026 on either date under discussion. That is the first new contract in a week, from a listing that is also still your best lead source. ⭐ The standing target is unchanged and it is the whole game: book 3–4 real appointments this week — and one of them held at 10:30 this morning.

money.note: ⚠️ THE SWEEP FIRED AT 6:47 THIS MORNING WITH THREE SEPARATE TRIGGERS AT ONCE and an alert went to your inbox. THE SHAPE OF IT, WITHOUT NUMBERS: the fortnight's scheduled bills materially exceed the bank-stamped balance, so the account is projected short before those bills clear. That is a forecast, not a bounce. ✅ NOTHING HAS ACTUALLY FAILED — a direct sweep of the last 24 hours finds no returned item, no insufficient-funds notice and no low-balance warning. Fourth clean day on the only signal that is directly observable. ✅ AND THE INVESTMENT SIDE DID REAL WORK: the brokerage position rallied on a verified earnings beat and net worth improved meaningfully over two days. 🔴 THE ONE GENUINELY SERIOUS THING IS UNCHANGED: you confirmed Thursday night that the accounting system's cash figure is overstated by a very large multiple because its bank connection expired and was never re-linked. Every routine that has read the books for cash has been reading a number far too high. Only the bank-stamped figure is usable until that link is restored. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS NOT THE PROBLEM: August models above the survive line. September is the hole — and Fieldstone going under contract this morning is the first real movement toward filling it.

isa.decayPolicy: ⚠️ 54 OPEN, UP FROM 47 THIS AFTERNOON, WITH 14 AT p1 — AND EVERY p1 IS OVERDUE OR DUE TODAY. ⭐ THE LIST IS NOT ROTTING, IT IS UNATTENDED, and the growth is mostly the day working: six of the new rows are staged drafts waiting on your send-or-kill, and a large block of the rest are contactless address-only seller records queued for re-check — records that arrived with no name, no phone and no email, correctly held at zero touch rather than guessed at. 🔥 THE p1 BLOCK IS WHERE THE MONEY IS: four named buyers off a single listing ad, a past client who replied to a reconnect email in 82 minutes, a Panama City seller who asked for a valuation in her own words, two land questions, and now TWO named buyer's agents on the same listing whose only objection has already been answered by a price cut neither was told about. 🔴 THE NUMBER THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU IS NOT 54 — IT IS THAT THE OLDEST p1 HAS ZERO TOUCHES OF ANY KIND, FIVE DAYS IN, and he came off the exact ad that went under contract this morning. ✅ REAL PROGRESS TODAY: you worked your own drafts folder at 8:09 and dispositioned eleven of them in thirteen minutes, three stale p1s chasing already-resolved problems were retired by evidence, and six first-touch texts went out on your DNC ruling after it had sat fifteen hours. ⚠️ Six inbound leads still cannot be texted at all — they typed a number into your own form that carries a do-not-call marker, and no rule exists yet for what to do with them. ⚠️ Four of today's ten database rows have no phone number, because the file that joins a name to a phone never made it off the old machine.
isa.sweepCadence: ✅ CADENCE IS FULLY RESTORED AND HELD ALL DAY — roughly twenty sweeps since 6:04 AM against Friday's zero, on a clean half-hourly incremental, and the last several were true zeros on every instrument rather than gaps. The instant responder, dark about 29 hours and carried as an open p1 all morning, proved itself alive at 11:29 by sending a real first-touch to a brand-new IDX buyer lead with the follow-up text nine minutes later; that p1 was closed by evidence, not assumption. ⚖️ AN 8:11 AM ALARM WAS INVESTIGATED AND REFUTED RATHER THAN BELIEVED: the sweep declared a hard send-rule breach — four sequence emails apparently sent without permission — and demoted its own send lane. A controlled test at 9:22 kept four test drafts pending and proved the mechanism it blamed does not send. The real cause was you clearing your own drafts folder. No breach happened, and the demotion was unwound in-run. 🛑 THE SEND GATES ARE DOING EXACTLY WHAT YOU WROTE: cold and never-contacted leads auto-send, everyone else drafts, clients and agents get no email at all. ⚖️ THREE QUESTIONS REPEAT EVERY RUN UNTIL YOU RULE THEM: your physical business address for cold-email footers — which has already cost one hot never-contacted Panama City seller a sent email today, asked at 9:25 this morning and unanswered since; whether the fleet may DRAFT a note to a co-op agent when you explicitly ask for one, asked five times and answered with a call script five times; and the import gate that has shut the phone-only prospecting engine down completely.
